findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to the start of `day` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the given day. This breaks the function's contract and any code that relies on it, such as `rangeEnd` in `src/range.ts`. Revert to the original logic or adjust the contract and all callers.

summary.problem: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the given day, breaking its contract and downstream usage.
summary.done_well: The refactor reuses startOfDay to avoid duplication.
